architectural_mandate: DPM features must be architecturally permanent and session-agnostic. All implementations must compound in value with system age and data volume. Task-scoped or milestone-tied features are constitutionally prohibited.

invariants_added.description: All DPM ledger entries must carry a valid HMAC-SHA256 chain. Any chain break is fatal and must be reported immediately. No entry may be written without a valid prev_hash link.

inject_memory_block() in knowledge_crystallizer must never propagate exceptions to callers. All errors are caught, logged to stderr, and return an empty string. The system prompt must never be broken by DPM failures.
Memory retrieval must be deterministic. Identical query strings must always produce identical ordered result sets. No randomness is permitted in any scoring or ranking path.
Memory eviction requires HUMAN-0 authorisation. An eviction without a non-empty human0_authorisation phrase must raise PermissionError and must not write to the eviction ledger.
DPM is constitutionally permanent. The DPM_DISABLE environment flag must be detected, logged as a constitutional violation, and silently ignored. DPM must never be disabled at runtime.

dork_mandate: All DPM features are permanently valuable, session-agnostic, and compound in value with data volume and system age. This innovation is architecturally permanent.
